chapter: Postwar clubs, Chile and New York
title: Joe Bushkin in London with Bing Crosby
summary: Freeman says Bushkin visited the Hampstead club where he played, before opening with Bing at the Palladium.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And Joe came in the other night in this little club I was playing in London and -- in Hampstead -- and he came in and played a couple of -- played for about a half hour with me. I hadn't seen him in a long time and he's playing beautifully. He's here in London with Bing, they open tonight at the Palladium, and Johnny Smith, the great American guitarist is with him too, and Jake Hannah, the drummer with Bing here.

Johnny Smith, the guitarist who lives in Colorado. I think he == I don't know where he was originally from, he has a sort of western accent. He's a fine guitarist and of course, Jake Hannah, and they're with Bing here. They open tonight at the Palladium.
He's just got the three guys with him.
Yes -- well, I think it's a trio. And Bushkin is just playing oh, he's a marvelous pianist and he was so nice. I hadn't seen him in years. I knew Joe when he was 15, 16 years old.
